stages.title: Freeze census, provenance and source ownership
stages.hazard: Lose unique source or accept substituted evidence through moving references.
stages.control: Pin revision and patch identities; obtain owner-frozen dirty manifests; require explicit coverage dispositions.
stages.acceptance: All source records and newly discovered heads have owner/provenance/coverage records; unresolved ownership blocks affected imports.
stages.risk_basis: Ordinal analyst assessment of proposed integration failure modes; O=3 is credible exposure, not a measured incident probability.

stages.title: Establish authoritative tooling and common build baseline
stages.hazard: A stale CLI, expired task attempt or mismatched NIF ABI produces false clearance.
stages.control: Verify Sa-plan binary/source behavior, task-attempt fencing, exact Nix/OTP/NIF provisioning and baseline tests.
stages.acceptance: Authority negative tests and candidate-bound baseline pass; no missing kernel is counted as healthy.
stages.risk_basis: Ordinal analyst assessment of proposed integration failure modes; O=3 is credible exposure, not a measured incident probability.

stages.title: Reconcile authenticated ingress and bounded framing as one repaired unit
stages.hazard: An authentication regression or unbounded body reader reaches the network boundary.
stages.control: Compose all three fixes, preserve current routes, exercise malformed framing, bounded reads and real authentication.
stages.acceptance: Historical positive/adversarial tests rerun on the reconciled tree, current routes covered, independent boundary review complete.
stages.risk_basis: Ordinal analyst assessment of proposed integration failure modes; O=3 is credible exposure, not a measured incident probability.

stages.title: Reconcile release assurance and preserve missing evidence
stages.hazard: A rewritten patch omits evidence or restores an obsolete policy/tool implementation.
stages.control: Compare both versions at path/hunk level; retain historical receipts and rebuild current tools.
stages.acceptance: All release/50-cycle deltas have explicit disposition; native/Mojo parity and release checks pass on exact current inputs.
stages.risk_basis: Ordinal analyst assessment of proposed integration failure modes; O=3 is credible exposure, not a measured incident probability.

stages.title: Integrate manual GUI/TUI testing with authenticated release path
stages.hazard: A test UI contacts production or displays a stale build as current.
stages.control: Use isolated data, current release identity, same-origin Tailnet links, browser/TUI update checks and lease-bound listener.
stages.acceptance: Test and read-only real-data journeys, negative cases and manual guide agree with the integrated package identity.
stages.risk_basis: Ordinal analyst assessment of proposed integration failure modes; O=3 is credible exposure, not a measured incident probability.

stages.title: Reconcile Solo5 source provenance, receipt validation and formal evidence
stages.hazard: Fabricated, stale or weakly bound tender evidence causes false isolation/admission claims.
stages.control: Recheck S13-01 through S13-08; share typed receipt validation and bind physical results to exact binaries and context.
stages.acceptance: Each source delta is accounted for; required model, implementation and physical controls pass independently; application migration remains separately evidenced.
stages.risk_basis: Ordinal analyst assessment of proposed integration failure modes; O=3 is credible exposure, not a measured incident probability.

stages.title: Compose final candidate and complete independent verification
stages.hazard: Separately passing branches are treated as a passing combined release.
stages.control: Freeze final tree, build/test full composition, review all 17 aspects and reconcile census coverage.
stages.acceptance: Exact candidate receipt set and independent review pass; no selected delta or required gate remains unknown.
stages.risk_basis: Ordinal analyst assessment of proposed integration failure modes; O=3 is credible exposure, not a measured incident probability.

stages.title: Land verified source under serialized integration authority
stages.hazard: A stale integrator overwrites concurrent main or moves it to an unverified tree.
stages.control: Recheck task attempt, integration/main fence, peer acknowledgements, current main and candidate identity immediately before movement.
stages.acceptance: Main advances only to the exact verified descendant; post-move readback matches; production is unchanged.
stages.risk_basis: Ordinal analyst assessment of proposed integration failure modes; O=3 is credible exposure, not a measured incident probability.

stages.title: Close coverage, synchronize references and publish handoff
stages.hazard: Peers keep developing from incorrectly reported state or source history is deleted prematurely.
stages.control: Publish exact source/evidence references with readbacks; preserve peer heads; finalize Sa-plan receipts and additive KM links.
stages.acceptance: All census records have terminal reviewed dispositions and main targets; no unaccounted unique code; leases released.
stages.risk_basis: Ordinal analyst assessment of proposed integration failure modes; O=3 is credible exposure, not a measured incident probability.
